diagram_math_checks.evidence: Definition lines 48–53 uses I_j=[jh,(j+1)h), U_j^0 as its average, and U_j^{n+1} from three time-n states. The three adjacent rectangles represent I_{j-1}, I_j, I_{j+1} in increasing spatial order, labelled U_{j-1}^n,U_j^n,U_{j+1}^n; only the lower update label has time n+1.

The arrow across the left face of the central cell carries F(U_{j-1}^n,U_j^n), the arrow across its right face carries F(U_j^n,U_{j+1}^n). Both arrows point right, matching the signed positive-rightward convention and Q_{j+1/2}=F(U_j,U_{j+1}) in def-conservative-finite-volume-scheme. Arrow direction denotes sign convention, not a claim that numerical flux values are positive.

The lower label U_j^{n+1}=U_j^n-lambda(right flux-left flux) agrees exactly with the displayed recurrence at line 53: a rightward right-face flux is subtracted and a rightward left-face flux is added. Adjacent cells use the shared value with opposite signs.

The figure asserts no stronger stability claim. For H(a,b,c)=b-lambda(F(b,c)-F(a,b)), monotonicity of F in a and antitonicity in b imply nonnegative outer coordinate increments; the central increment is bounded below by (1-lambda(L1+L2)) times its state increment. The unchanged full CFL gives this nonnegativity; consistency gives H(s,s,s)=s. These are exactly lem-monotone-fv-update-preserves-range-and-tvd steps 1.2 and 2.1, read in full.
